extension.construction: DISCLOSED registered extension, not M117's uniform rule. The 6144-atom dictionary is a prefix of the sealed 8192-pool (M117 exact, t1 anchor). The 8192-atom dictionary is the FULL sealed 8192-pool in M117's seeded-permutation order. The 12288-atom dictionary APPENDS 4096 new atoms and the 16384-atom dictionary APPENDS 8192 new atoms after that 8192-atom prefix: new candidates are re-drawn (ext_pool_seed 42) from a re-derived M108 whitened-patch stream (same zca seeds; the rebuilt stream is verified against the whitener's mean/whiten before use), whitened with the same (mean, whiten), and ordered by a fresh seeded permutation (seed 42). The first 8192 atoms of every extended dictionary are EXACTLY the 8192-atom dictionary. HEAD-FIT NOTE (registered): the 12288/16384 closed-form ridges are fit via a memmap-backed Gram with CHUNKED-OUTPUT-ROW accumulation (same arithmetic, gram on D: instead of committed RAM) because (a) the in-RAM RidgeAccumulator needs two width^2 float64 arrays and OOMs at >= 32768 features on this 66 GB machine, and (b) the bundled scipy-openblas abort-crashes the process on the single M=width gemm at width >= 49152 (measured C-level abort at 4 and 24 threads; chunking the output rows to M=8192 per gemm avoids it and produces the bit-identical Gram). The memmap-backed fit is a mechanical memory/BLAS-management change, not a head change: same gram values, same standardised system, same solve.
